issuer: the Mississippi Department of Public Safety, Driver Service Bureau
note: The Driver Service Bureau's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives the regular Class R licence, original or renewal, for 4 years at $24.00 or 8 years at $47.00, and the identification card for 4 years at $17.00 or 8 years at $33.00 (each fee printed before its description); both are held as terms the holder chooses. Its Class R page says the minimum age for a licence is 16, so the licence is kept from 16; Mississippi also has an intermediate licence for young drivers whose terms weren't read (worth checking). No youngest age for the card was read. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then it held the 8-year licence and card only, and the 4-year ones were added from the same page.
